summary:
Imagine an astronaut on the way to Mars feeling sudden chest pain. With no doctor on board and a 44-minute wait for a reply from Houston, crews can feel completely alone during a medical emergency. We created ASTRA-MED to make sure no explorer—in space or on Earth—ever faces a health crisis without clear, calm guidance.

ASTRA-MED is an offline medical support companion installed directly inside the spacecraft. It connects comfortable ESP32 wearable sensors with our onboard ATLAS-01 server to watch over crew vitals and cabin air in real time, with zero internet required. Grounded in real flight data from NASA OSDR (Inspiration4), NASA HRP guidelines, and CSA CANS radiation records, ASTRA-MED translates complex sensor numbers into simple Green, Amber, or Red alerts. When seconds count, it speaks step-by-step flight-surgeon checklists aloud so any crewmate can help a partner with confidence, while protecting personal privacy via individual PINs and checking that onboard medicines remain safe from radiation.

Designed for the Moon and Mars, ASTRA-MED also brings accessible medical guidance to remote rural clinics, ships at sea, and isolated communities on Earth.
details:
How It Cares for the Crew Instead of making stressed astronauts read 500-page manuals or complex hospital graphs, ASTRA-MED keeps things calm and effortless. Comfortable ESP32 wearable sensors track heart rate, oxygen, temperature, blood pressure, glucose, and cabin CO2, filtering out zero-gravity movement noise first. That clean data goes straight to our local ATLAS-01 server inside the rocket using zero internet. In milliseconds, the screen shows a simple Green, Amber, or Red alert and speaks step-by-step instructions out loud ("Step 1: Put on portable oxygen mask...")so the assisting astronaut can keep both hands on their injured partner.

Built for Real Space Conditions (and Human Dignity)

  • Space-Tuned Alerts: In zero gravity, body fluids shift upward and confuse normal Earth monitors. We used NASA OSDR (Inspiration4) records and NASA-STD-3001 limits so natural body changes in space never trigger false alarms.
  • Proven Medical Safety (No Risky AI): We never gamble with lives using AI that could invent a wrong diagnosis. ASTRA-MED strictly follows pre-approved NASA Human Research Program (HRP) medical guides.
  • Crew Privacy: Astronauts often hide early symptoms if teammates can see their files on a shared screen. Every crew member's history is locked behind a personal PIN, unlocking automatically only during a life-threatening Red Alert.
  • Radiation-Safe Medicine & Offline Backup: Using Canadian Space Agency (CSA CANS) radiation data, our system tracks radiation inside the ship and warns the crew if liquid medicines get damaged, suggesting safe dry-powder backups. During radio blackouts, it saves all medical logs offline and syncs with Earth as soon as signal returns.

Why It Matters on Earth Because ASTRA-MED runs on affordable ESP32 hardware and needs zero internet, this exact same companion can bring life-saving medical care to isolated rural clinics, ships at sea, polar stations, and disaster zones here on Earth
